description: This file defines the interface OnKeyboardActionListener, which specifies callback methods for various keyboard actions such as key presses, releases, gestures, and other user interactions within the AnySoftKeyboard project.

classes.name: OnKeyboardActionListener
classes.description: An interface that defines callback methods for handling various keyboard actions and gestures.

methods.name: onPress
methods.description: Called when the user presses a key. This is sent before onKey. For keys that repeat, this is only called once.

methods.name: onRelease
methods.description: Called when the user releases a key. This is sent after onKey. For keys that repeat, this is only called once.

methods.name: onKey
methods.description: Send a key press to the listener, with details about the key, nearby alternatives, and whether initiated from UI.

methods.name: onMultiTapStarted
methods.description: Notify that multi-tap input has started.

methods.name: onMultiTapEnded
methods.description: Notify that multi-tap input has ended.

methods.name: onText
methods.description: Send a sequence of characters as a complete text to the listener.

methods.name: onTyping
methods.description: Send a sequence of characters as if they were typed.

methods.name: onCancel
methods.description: Called when the user releases a finger outside any key.

methods.name: onSwipeLeft
methods.description: Called when the user quickly moves the finger from right to left.

methods.name: onSwipeRight
methods.description: Called when the user quickly moves the finger from left to right.

methods.name: onSwipeDown
methods.description: Called when the user quickly moves the finger from up to down.

methods.name: onSwipeUp
methods.description: Called when the user quickly moves the finger from down to up.

methods.name: onPinch
methods.description: Called when the user performs a 'pinch' gesture with two fingers.

methods.name: onSeparate
methods.description: Called when the user performs a 'separate' gesture with two fingers.

methods.name: onFirstDownKey
methods.description: Called when the user touches the keyboard, with the primary key code.

methods.name: onGestureTypingInputStart
methods.description: Notify the start of gesture typing input, with coordinates, key, and event time.

methods.name: onGestureTypingInput
methods.description: Notify ongoing gesture typing input with coordinates and event time.

methods.name: onGestureTypingInputDone
methods.description: Notify that gesture sliding is done; returns true if handled.

methods.name: onLongPressDone
methods.description: Called when a long press gesture is completed on a key.
